data.one_liner: Standard representation for source code locations, spans, and human-friendly error messages.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes like SourceSpan and SourceFile to track positions in source code files. It allows packages to easily pass code locations around and generate clear, human-friendly error messages with line and column highlights.
use_when: You are writing a parser, compiler, linter, or code generator that needs to report source code errors.
You want to standardize source location tracking across multiple custom packages.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile application UI without any code parsing requirements.
strengths: Generates clean, human-friendly error messages with file context and line numbers.
Efficient means of computing line and column numbers using SourceFile.
Supports multi-span highlights and Unicode box-drawing characters.
weaknesses: Very niche utility package with no application outside of parsing and tooling.
